name: Henri Cash-Finlay: 'Fading Myths'
description: MOMENTUM presents Henri Cash-Finlay's 'Fading Myths,' opening Friday, February 27 with a reception from 7–11pm. The exhibition runs through March 8, 2026. Cash-Finlay's work interrogates mythologies in flux, examining how narratives erode, transform, and disappear over time. This is an opportunity to see emerging thought on cultural memory and storytelling.
